title: multi-sdk: unify auth/retries & streaming ergonomics; parity fixes; bump SDK versions to v1.190.0
author: Ellie Chen
release_notes: Bump SDKs to v1.190.0. Unify auth and retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. Improve streaming API ergonomics (consistent iterator/callback patterns). Parity fixes for response shapes and error codes across SDKs. Migration notes included.
description:
Context: Multiple customer reports and internal tests revealed subtle inconsistencies between the Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs around auth propagation, retry backoff behavior, and streaming ergonomics. This caused confusing developer experiences when switching languages and made cross-language e2e tests flaky. This PR unifies the auth token refresh and retry strategy implementations, standardizes the streaming interfaces, and applies parity fixes to align response/error shapes across SDKs.

What this change does: - Python: implement unified token refresh hook and expose a StreamAsyncIterator that mirrors TS behavior; add configurable retry middleware consistent with other SDKs. - TypeScript: refactor auth layer to use shared refresh interface, normalize backoff defaults, and expose a single streaming API surface for both browser/node. - Go: align retry jitter/backoff math with other SDKs, add helper for streaming that returns a channel + iterator helper for parity. - Testing: add cross-language e2e harness tests and unit tests for auth/retry edge cases. - Docs: update migration guide and quickstart snippets to show the new streaming pattern and auth configuration.

Checklist: - [x] Implement shared auth/retry semantics in each SDK - [x] Add unit tests and cross-language e2e tests - [x] Update docs and migration notes - [x] Bump package versions and changelogs to v1.190.0

Compatibility/migration: No runtime API breaking changes for the majority of users. There are small signature adjustments to streaming helpers (names harmonized); migration section in the docs shows before/after snippets and suggested one-line adapters for older call sites. If consumers depended on previous retry timing defaults, they should verify behavior — a compatibility flag is available via SDK config for a transitional period.

Motivation: Deliver a predictable cross-language developer experience (parity in semantics and ergonomics) and reduce support surface for multi-language customers. This also enables better multi-SDK integration tests in CI.

Related: ENG-3421 (unify retry semantics), PM-128 (streaming API ergonomics), SUP-9123 (customer support case triggered the Go backoff fix).
commits_summary: 7 commits: 1) python: add auth refresh hook and StreamAsyncIterator; 2) typescript: refactor auth provider and streaming surface; 3) go: align backoff and add stream helper; 4) e2e: cross-language harness and tests; 5) docs: migration guide and quickstarts; 6) changelogs: version bumps to v1.190.0 across SDKs; 7) fix: test flake fixes and CI adjustments.
